page: Microsoft Azure E372is_v7 is an isolated virtual machine belonging to the Esv7 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is equipped with an Intel x86_64 processor architecture and provides 372 dedicated virtual CPUs. The system features 2832.0 GB of RAM, which translates to a resource density of 7.61 GB of memory per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage operations rely on external volumes via its Premium Storage capability. It contains no graphics processing units and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are fully committed to the instance without virtualization sharing overhead.

The server is designed for high-density enterprise workloads where resource isolation and massive memory capacity are critical. It offers qualitative cost efficiency by allowing the consolidation of large-scale databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-intensive legacy migrations onto a single isolated environment.
